summary: Example registering an API token from an environment variable as a secret while assigning it.
questions: How do I register an API token from the environment as a secret?

answer_card.title: register_secret example
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
my_secret: "{{ lookup('env', 'API_TOKEN') | register_secret }}"
```

Later uses of `my_secret` are masked in output.
